show: bug-report.md (the arc bead description ONLY — symptom, log, core questions, env)
hide: vllm-vpd metadata gc.output_json (arc state / agreed_root_cause — the wrong+then-corrected narrative)
lane beads vllm-1yo, vllm-r3t (worker-a), vllm-0tj, vllm-6p0 (worker-b)

allow: huggingface.co model-repo files for the model under diagnosis: tokenizer_config.json, config.json, tokenizer.json, special_tokens_map.json
package/source documentation needed to read the code path
forbid: any lookup of THIS incident (the bug id, the PR/issue, anyone's diagnosis)
any vLLM commit past 41e7746b8; git fetch / walking forward
gc / bead-store access of any kind

why_this_case: Core question #1 literally asks what token 200028 is. The original run GUESSED a block terminator (<|end_message|>), both lanes tagged the mapping could_not_verify, and the coordinator marked aligned=high-confidence (correlated error). Ground truth: 200028 = <|begin_of_text|> (a BOS), which is anomalous post-JSON and hints at a second bug the guess masked.
